name: Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc.
blurb: Eos Energy manufactures zinc-bromide long-duration battery storage systems using its proprietary Znyth chemistry. Unlike lithium-ion batteries (typically two hours of discharge), Eos's Z3 modules support four to sixteen-plus hours of storage with no degradation penalty — a profile suited to grid-scale renewable energy firming and data-centre backup. The company received a $305 million DOE loan guarantee in November 2024 to build two manufacturing lines in Turtle Creek, Pennsylvania.
recent: Eos guided full-year 2025 revenue of $150M–$190M (vs ~$16M in 2024), targeting a major production ramp in Q4 2025. Analysts project $477M in 2026 revenue and $1B in 2027. Four manufacturing lines combined are expected to produce over 8 GWh of annual capacity by 2026. A new Z3 battery architecture was launched to improve simplicity, safety, and AI-enabled grid controls. The company is positioning zinc-bromide storage as a complement to AI data-centre power demand.
